messages.content: Get the protein sequence of human HbA1c, normal hemoglobin, and rat hemoglobin and their 3D models

function.name: protein_info_get_sequence_and_3D
function.description: Retrive the sequence and 3D models of proteins. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

The function returns any. We should call it three times. The user didn't specify whether they want all in one call or separate calls. The function signature only accepts one protein_name at a time. So we need to call it three times. We can do separate calls. The user wants "normal hemoglobin" - ambiguous: maybe human normal hemoglobin? But they also ask for human HbA1c. So "normal hemoglobin" might refer to human adult hemoglobin (HbA). So we need sequences for human HbA1c (which is glycated form of HbA), human normal hemoglobin (HbA), and rat hemoglobin (maybe rat adult hemoglobin). We can provide sequences. For 3D models, we can provide PDB IDs. For human HbA, PDB ID 1A3N or 1HHO. For HbA1c, there may not be a PDB structure because it's glycated. But we can provide a model or note that no structure available. For rat hemoglobin, PDB ID 1RHO. We can use the function to retrieve sequences and 3D models. Let's call the function for each.

We need to output the results. We'll call the function three times. Use the function.
